title: Seminiferous tubule in section
back: Spermatogonia at the wall → spermatocytes → spermatids → sperms in the lumen. Sertoli cells nourish; Leydig cells between tubules make androgens.

title: Human sperm
back: Head (acrosome + haploid nucleus), neck, middle piece of mitochondria (energy), tail. 200–300 million per ejaculation.

title: Ovary: follicle stages
back: Primary → secondary → tertiary (antrum) → Graafian → ovulation → corpus luteum (progesterone).

title: 28-day menstrual cycle
back: LH surge on about day 14 → ovulation. Estrogen peaks before ovulation; progesterone after it, from the corpus luteum.

title: Spermatogenesis
back: Spermiogenesis turns spermatids into sperms (no division); spermiation releases them into the lumen.

title: Oogenesis
back: Oogonia form only in the foetus. One mother cell gives one ovum; meiosis II finishes only after sperm entry.

title: Zygote to implantation
back: Fertilisation in the ampulla; cleavage in the isthmus; trophoblast embeds in the endometrium; inner cell mass forms the embryo.

title: Spermatogenesis vs oogenesis
back: Sperm: from puberty, continuous, meiosis II in testis. Ovum: starts in foetus, cyclic, meiosis II after sperm entry.

title: Trophoblast vs inner cell mass
back: Trophoblast is the outer layer and forms chorionic villi; the inner cell mass holds stem cells and becomes the embryo.

title: Parturition: positive feedback
back: Stronger contractions release more oxytocin until the baby is born. Colostrum, the first milk, carries antibodies.

title: SEVEN UP: path of sperm
back: Seminiferous tubules → Epididymis → Vas deferens → Ejaculatory duct → (Nothing) → Urethra → Penis.

title: Pregnancy-only hormones
back: hCG and hPL (placenta) and relaxin (ovary) are made only during pregnancy.
